About Peptide Chooser

An independent site that helps people in the United States compare peptide products and the sellers behind them.

Why this site exists

Peptides are sold in very different ways: as approved prescription drugs, as cosmetics, as supplements and as research chemicals. The same name can mean a lab-tested product from a licensed pharmacy or an untested vial. Most websites that rank them are run by sellers or paid by sellers, and few show where their claims come from.

We built Peptide Chooser to put that information in one place: what each product is, how it is regulated, what the evidence says, what it really costs and who is selling it.

What we do

  • Compare peptide products and sellers using the same published criteria for everyone.
  • Show the source and date behind every claim, including FDA status and warning letters.
  • Include FDA-approved alternatives when they are the better-supported option.

What we do not do

  • We do not sell peptides or any other product.
  • We do not give personal medical advice or dosing instructions.
  • We do not accept payment for a higher rating or position.

Who writes this site

Pages are written and checked by the Peptide Chooser editorial team. We have no medical reviewer yet; until we do, every claim links to its source and no page gives dosing advice.

How we make money

Some links on this site are paid links. If you buy through one, the seller may pay us a commission at no extra cost to you. These links are labeled. See our affiliate and medical disclosure for details.
